newsitem.title: SPAIN: Most Spanish 1996 job contracts temporary - study.
newsitem.headline: Most Spanish 1996 job contracts temporary - study.

text.p: Spain's labour ministry said on Friday more than 96 percent of employment contracts created in 1996 were temporary and half of those had durations of less than a month.
Data published by the ministry revealed that of the 8.6 million jobs registered during 1996, just 353,786 were of a permanent nature.
"This represents 4.1 percent of total contracts completed in 1996," the labour ministry said in a study.
Of the total contracts registered, 70 percent had a duration of less than three months.
